answer: A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The crystal counter is kept in plume and canyon makes public each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4678 identities would post 1614 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
